basics.name: Aishwarya Chandrasekaran
basics.label: Lecturer - Utah State University
basics.summary: Passionate educator at the department of Environment and Society teaching online courses on Python programming, portfolio development and remote sensing visualization as part of the Online GeoAI certificate program at USU. Proven expertise in Remote Sensing, UAS mapping, GIS, Forest Measurements, Machine Learning and Deep Learning. Proficient in R, Python, and image processing tools. A proud dog mom (fish and bunny parent as well) who loves a perspective vision of forests as much as an aerial view.
